name: Mini squat
description: A small knee bend from standing, then straightening back up. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand side-on to the screen, feet hip-width apart. Hold a stable support if you need one.
Bend your knees a little, as far as your therapist has asked.

camera.guidance: Stand side-on so your hip, knee and ankle stay in view.

messages.target_not_reached: Bend your knees a little further.

form_rules.message: Keep your chest up as you bend.

setup: Stand side-on to the screen, next to a stable support you can hold if needed.
Feet hip-width apart, weight evenly on both feet.

cues.move: Bend your knees a little, toward the green line.

key_points: Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Bend only as far as your therapist has asked.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds down and 2 seconds up.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
